ellie (prodsec): Heads-up: intel just hit our desk — active exploit reported for OpenSSL 3.x (affects bindings used by our KMS agent). vendor advisory says remote key material exposure is possible. marking P1.

kai (eng-runtime): ack. which images/plugins use the vulnerable binding? our kms-agent container uses python-cryptography wheel linked to openssl.

maria (sec-eng): CVE details: attacker can craft a handshake to leak key material in certain asymmetric flows. exploit seen in the wild for on-prem appliances. advisory: https://example.advisories/openssl-3xxx (internal mirror).

jonathan (oncall): live systems? Dedicated customer infra that uses our Private KMS connector could be impacted. I'm running a quick grep on deployed images now.

deploy-bot: build-1234 started for kms-agent patch branch fix/openssl-3xxx-mitigate.

jonathan (oncall): grep results: 
- docker-registry/redwood/kms-agent:prod-2026.01 -> links to libcrypto 3.0.7
- private-kms-adapter images for two customers also show same.

kai (eng-runtime): immediate mitigations: 1) stop KMS agent process on non-critical nodes, 2) replace with statically-linked fallback using BoringSSL? Too heavy. Better: apply upstream OpenSSL patch or disable affected handshake ciphers on agent side.

maria (sec-eng): Priority plan (short):
- patch images with OpenSSL patched wheel (we have vendor backport available).
- disable ECDHE-RSA-PSS handshake on agent by forcing TLS profiles to safe list.
- enable extra audit logging for KMS operations.
- rotate affected keys where exposure risk is high.

ellie (prodsec): action owners: kai -> build & verify patched images; jonathan -> orchestration/rolling restart and canary; maria -> audit rules + risk classification and comms draft; sarah -> privacy/legal triage for customer notification.

kai (eng-runtime): starting build. I'll run quick crypto test harness:
```
# verify tls profile rejects bad ciphers
python -m tests.kms_tls_test --image kms-agent:patched
```

jonathan (oncall): canary plan: restart 2 canary hosts in us-central, run smoke, then 20% of hosts, then full if no errors. rollback tag ready: kms-agent:prod-2026.01.

maria (sec-eng): audit logging: adding structured event for every KMS decrypt/unwrap call with caller_id + request_id + key_id. pushing rule to stack: logs -> SIEM with immediate alert on anomalous mass unwraps.

sarah (privacy): if keys likely exposed we need to notify legal and affected customers within 72 hours. gathering list of customers using Private KMS connector—jonathan can you export map?

jonathan (oncall): exporting now. 3 customers on private infra, 12 using Dedicated with KMS proxied. sending list to sarah.

ops-bot: incident-created: INC-2026-045, severity=P1, owner=ellie (prodsec). Pager duty notified.

kai (eng-runtime): built patched image, running unit + crypto tests. build logs: https://ci.internal/builds/1234.

maria (sec-eng): temp mitigation command for operators (to avoid restart if needed):
```
# enforce safe ciphers in /etc/kms-agent/tls.conf
tls_ciphers = TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256
systemctl reload kms-agent
```

jonathan (oncall): Applied on two canaries. smoke ok. no latency spikes.

ellie (prodsec): good. maria, prepare comms draft for customers with suggested customer steps (rotate keys, revoke cached tokens). include recommended timeline.

maria (sec-eng): draft ready — TL;DR + technical appendix. excerpt: "We have deployed a patched KMS agent image to mitigate CVE-2026-XXXX. Customers using Private KMS should plan key rotations; Dedicated customers will be auto-patched; contact support for expedited rotation." will share for review.

sarah (privacy): reviewed — add required legal phrasing and opt-in support line.

kai (eng-runtime): starting 20% rollout now. CI + canary passed. monitoring in Datadog for errors and unwrap rate.

jonathan (oncall): monitoring dashboards: no spike in unwraps, CPU & latency stable.

ellie (prodsec): decision: continue full rollout, commence key rotation for high-priv keys. maria, provide list of key IDs flagged for forced rotation.

maria (sec-eng): generating list. priority = customer-provided symmetric keys used for signing and master wrapping keys. will post in incident ticket.

ops-bot: rollout-progress: 50% -> 80% -> 100% at 1768673000.

kai (eng-runtime): rollout finished. images: kms-agent:prod-2026.02 (patched).

ellie (prodsec): postmortem action items (short):
- CA1: finish automated dependency scanning to catch linked native libs (owner: kai).
- CA2: add preflight step to alert when KMS image links to vulnerable libcrypto (owner: maria).
- CA3: run key-rotation runbook drills quarterly (owner: jonathan).

maria (sec-eng): adding audit log retention + search dashboards. will follow up with queries to detect odd unwrap patterns.

sarah (privacy): prepping customer notifications. legal approved language.

ellie (prodsec): closing thread here — INC-2026-045 assigned. migrating notes to incident doc. :thumbsup:

kai (eng-runtime): quick note: we should consider moving KMS bindings to a certified static build to reduce surface area. opened RFC: rfc/kms-static-crypto.md

jonathan (oncall): thanks everyone.
